title: Detecting Variant Contamination in LLMs via Variance of Generation Distribution
authors_zh: Renzhao Liang, Jingru Chen, Bo Jia, Yidong Wang, Jin Ke, Linfeng Zhang, Xin Wang, Bo Deng, Cunxiang Wang
paper_type_zh: 变体数据污染检测方法
best_for_zh: 需要审计非逐字基准泄漏的 LLM 评测研究者。
one_line: Variance-based detector targets paraphrased and structurally transformed leakage.
以生成分布方差检测释义与结构变体污染。
why: It adds a concrete reliability or failure-mode evaluation surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13: contamination, verifier/reward failure, reward hacking, or evaluator reliability.

title: Problem
问题
html:
LLM benchmark scores can be inflated when training data contains a semantically equivalent paraphrase or structural transformation of a test item. Such variant contamination is not verbatim leakage, so perplexity, sampling consistency, edit distance, and embedding similarity can miss it while memorization masquerades as reasoning.

The paper formalizes this setting and introduces DVD, a single-sample detector based on variance in a temperature-sampled local generation distribution. It also builds controlled variant-contamination benchmarks and fine-tunes models on variants to test the detector.

若训练语料含有测试题的语义等价释义或结构变体，LLM 的基准分数会被记忆抬高。这类变体污染不是逐字泄漏，困惑度、采样一致性、编辑距离和嵌入相似度可能漏检，却把记忆误当成推理能力。

论文形式化该问题并提出 DVD：以温度采样下局部生成分布的方差作为单样本检测信号。作者还构造受控变体污染基准，并在变体数据上微调模型来检验检测器。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: DVD models variant contamination as alternation between memory adherence and perturbation drift. It samples the local distribution under temperature and uses variance in the synthetic difficulty of low-probability tokens: contaminated variants are expected to fluctuate more, whereas clean items remain smoother. The contribution includes a constructed Omni-MATH/SuperGPQA variant benchmark and supplementary material. No separately verified code repository or named downloadable general dataset was found; reuse requires checking the official supplement.
DVD 将变体污染建模为记忆遵循与扰动漂移之间的交替。它在温度下采样局部生成分布，并利用低概率 token 合成难度的方差：污染变体预期波动更大，干净题目则更平滑。贡献包括构造的 Omni-MATH、SuperGPQA 变体基准与补充材料。未找到独立核实的代码仓库或具名可下载通用数据集；复用须先核验官方补充材料。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Create matched variants. Generate and filter semantic or structural variants of Omni-MATH and SuperGPQA items, retaining a controlled clean/variant comparison set.
  1. Simulate contamination. Fine-tune Qwen2.5 and Llama3.1 models of different scales on the variant data; the fine-tuned-versus-clean condition supplies the detector labels.
  1. Sample local behavior. For a test item, run temperature sampling to obtain local output-distribution behavior rather than a single fixed likelihood score.
  1. Compute DVD. Derive the paper’s synthetic-difficulty signal for low-probability tokens and aggregate its variance. High abnormal variance is the decision signal for variant contamination.
  1. Compare baselines. Evaluate against perplexity, Min-k%, CDD edit distance, and embedding similarity under the same constructed settings. Fix model checkpoints, variant generator/filter, temperatures, sample count, and tokenization; unreported hyperparameters are unknown.

1. 构造匹配变体。为 Omni-MATH、SuperGPQA 题目生成并筛选语义或结构变体，保留受控的干净题—变体题比较集。
  1. 模拟污染。在变体数据上微调不同规模的 Qwen2.5、Llama3.1；微调模型与干净模型的条件提供检测标签。
  1. 采样局部行为。对测试题进行温度采样，获得局部输出分布行为，而非只取一个固定似然分数。
  1. 计算 DVD。导出低概率 token 的合成难度信号并聚合其方差；异常高方差是变体污染的判决信号。
  1. 比较基线。在同一受控设置下与困惑度、Min-k%、CDD 编辑距离和嵌入相似度对比。须固定模型 checkpoint、变体生成与筛选器、温度、采样数和分词器；未披露超参数为未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim — variance of local generation behavior is a more reliable signal of variant contamination than static lexical or likelihood signals.

Controlled setup — variant-contaminated and clean conditions are constructed from Omni-MATH and SuperGPQA, with Qwen2.5 and Llama3.1 models fine-tuned at different scales. DVD is compared with perplexity, Min-k%, CDD, and embedding similarity; the controlled difference is exposure to semantic/structural variants.

Result — the paper reports DVD consistently outperforming all listed baselines across its datasets and model families, with robustness to hyperparameters. The accessible primary abstract does not provide a table value that can be safely quoted here.

Boundary — results are from simulated fine-tuning contamination and two domains. They support the detector under those constructions, not proof for unknown real pretraining corpora.

主张——局部生成行为的方差比静态词面或似然信号更能检测变体污染。

受控设置——从 Omni-MATH、SuperGPQA 构造污染和干净条件，在不同规模 Qwen2.5、Llama3.1 上微调；DVD 与困惑度、Min-k%、CDD、嵌入相似度比较。主要受控差异是是否见过语义或结构变体。

结果——论文报告 DVD 在所选数据集和模型家族上持续优于这些基线，并对超参数较稳健。当前可访问的论文摘要没有可安全逐项引用的表格数值。

边界——实验是两类领域上的模拟微调污染，支持该构造下的检测，不等同于能够识别未知真实预训练语料中的全部泄漏。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Existing detectors use a static score, surface similarity, or reproduction cue and mainly target verbatim exposure. DVD changes the measurement object to stochastic local-generation variance induced by one test item. Its claimed novelty is the memory-adherence/perturbation-drift signature and a benchmark of semantically equivalent variants, not another similarity threshold.
既有检测器使用静态分数、词面相似度或复现线索，主要针对逐字暴露。DVD 将测量对象改为单题诱发的随机局部生成方差。它声称的新意是记忆遵循—扰动漂移特征及语义等价变体基准，而不是再设一个相似度阈值。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The evidence relies on generated variants and simulated fine-tuning contamination. Real pretraining leakage may have different frequency, mixture, and transformation patterns; reproduce with a target-domain contamination protocol before operational use.

DVD assumes temperature-sampled variance distinguishes memory from reasoning drift. Sampling choices, model version, tokenizer, and decoding budget can affect that statistic; publish sensitivity curves and a false-positive audit.

The submission is withdrawn and the public paper page does not disclose affiliations. The supplementary artifact must be independently inspected for its data, license, and exact reproducibility scope.

证据依赖生成变体与模拟微调污染。真实预训练泄漏的频率、混合方式和变换模式可能不同；投入使用前应以目标领域污染协议复测。

DVD 假设温度采样方差能区分记忆与推理漂移。采样选择、模型版本、分词器和解码预算都会影响该统计量；应发布敏感性曲线并审计假阳性。

该投稿已撤回，公开论文页未披露机构。补充材料的数据、许可与可复现范围仍须独立核验。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
An evaluation maintainer with suspected paraphrase leakage can create matched original/variant items, run temperature-sampled DVD on a target model, and output an item-level contamination flag plus a manual-review queue. Success is separation on held-out clean and intentionally contaminated controls, not a high benchmark score.

An auditor can stress-test a detector against semantic transformations. Do not use DVD as a universal certificate when temperature sampling is unavailable, the task is outside tested domains, or a clean control set cannot be built; use provenance review and complementary detectors.

怀疑存在释义泄漏的评测维护者，可构造原题—变体题对，在目标模型上运行温度采样 DVD，输出逐题污染标记和人工复核队列。成功标准是能分离留出的干净对照与刻意污染对照，而不是基准高分。

审计者可用该流程压力测试检测器面对语义变换的表现。若无法温度采样、任务超出已测领域，或不能建立干净对照集，不能把 DVD 当通用认证；应结合来源核查和其他检测器。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Positioning: DVD detects semantically transformed benchmark leakage, not only exact-copy contamination.
  2. Method handle: temperature-sampled low-probability-token difficulty variance is the decision signal; abnormal fluctuation flags contamination.
  3. Artifact handle: controlled Omni-MATH/SuperGPQA variants and a supplement are reported; separate code release and license are unverified.
  4. Evidence anchor: Qwen2.5 and Llama3.1 fine-tuning experiments report DVD above PPL, Min-k%, CDD, and embedding baselines; exact table values require supplement verification.
  5. Reuse decision: use for item-level leakage triage; first calibrate sampling and false positives on target clean/contaminated controls.

1. 定位：DVD 检测语义变换后的基准泄漏，而不只查逐字复制。
  2. 方法抓手：温度采样的低概率 token 难度方差是判决信号；异常波动提示污染。
  3. 数据与工具：论文报告受控 Omni-MATH、SuperGPQA 变体和补充材料；独立代码发布与许可尚未核实。
  4. 证据锚点：Qwen2.5、Llama3.1 微调实验报告 DVD 优于 PPL、Min-k%、CDD 与嵌入基线；精确表格值须核验补充材料。
  5. 复用决定：适合逐题泄漏分流；先在目标干净、污染对照上校准采样与假阳性。
